namespace.description: The namespace this chart CREATES and installs its page objects into. It is the RBAC boundary the chart exists for — a group with no RoleBinding here cannot `list` the page roots, so the portal sidebar never shows them and the page body 403s on a deep link. The release itself stays in the portal's namespace (the shell), and only these objects live here.
namespace.title: namespace

readerGroups.description: Groups granted read of these pages in `namespace`. A group listed here sees /dashboard in the sidebar and can open it; a group absent cannot list the page roots, so the entry never renders. No schema default: the installer applies schema defaults, so one here would silently re-assert itself over a group set through componentValues. The chart default lives in values.yaml instead.
readerGroups.title: readerGroups

inboxPages.title: inboxPages
inboxPages.description: The page each Dashboard inbox source belongs to, as its root Flex (`root`) in the namespace its page chart installs into (`namespace`, that chart's own `namespace` value). The inbox reads a source only for a caller who may GET that root, the object the sidebar must read for the page's entry to show, so a source whose page the caller cannot open is left out rather than drawn as having nothing waiting. Set a namespace here when that page chart is installed with a non-default `namespace`. No schema default: the default lives here.

namespace.description: The namespace that page chart installs into (its `namespace` value).

root.description: The name of the page's root Flex.
